title: Real-time wildfire perimeters from satellite imagery
summary: A model using geostationary imagery tracks fire perimeters with updates every 10–15 minutes and, according to the page, is more accurate than similar products and the previous model based on NOAA GOES-16/17 data; shown in Search and Maps for large fires in the United States, Mexico, much of Canada and Australia. Resolution is 2 km; clouds can hide fires; figures appear only in an image.

evidence.tested: Fire perimeters were compared with official fire scars using precision, recall and distance metrics; a comparison with an earlier GOES-16/17 model and a 2022 US test set unavailable during training are also reported.
evidence.unknown: The post states limitations: smoke and clouds hide fires, resolution is about 2 km and coarser away from nadir, and coverage is limited to large fires in the listed regions; no paper is cited.
evidence.ai_role: A model using geostationary satellite imagery tracks fire perimeters with updates every 10-15 minutes.
